nameOrigin: hard shell of nuts or oysters

pokedexEntries.go: The BERRIES it stores in its vase-like shell decompose and become a gooey liquid.

pokedexEntries.si: It stores BERRIES inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

pokedexEntries.cr: The fluid secreted by its toes carves holes in rocks for nesting and can be mixed with BERRIES to make a drink.

pokedexEntries.rs: SHUCKLE quietly hides itself under rocks, keeping its body concealed inside its hard shell while eating berries it has stored away. The berries mix with its body fluids to become a juice.
